name: Joy
description: For those who love carnival, this paints its ideal to enjoy with friends and to show yourself off to your enemies meanwhile you are killing it inside maps.
interestingFacts: This paint was only available in the Brazilian and Spanish servers.
Joy (Alegria) was a holiday paint that celebrated the day of "Carnaval" from February 24 to March 1st, 2017.
The paint was sold in the garage on the day of "Carnival" February 10-13 2018 for 120 000 crystals.

The paint is now only available to those players who purchased the paint and whose game accounts were transferred from the Spanish and Brazilian servers to the European one during the migration on April 16, 2020.
